auto_graded_items.title: 听辨 1
auto_graded_items.prompt: 先点朗读，再选择对话发生在哪里。
auto_graded_items.speech_text: Could you return these books before the library closes at six?
auto_graded_items.explanation: books、return 和 library closes 指向图书馆场景。

auto_graded_items.title: 听辨 2
auto_graded_items.prompt: 先点朗读，再选择会议开始时间。
auto_graded_items.speech_text: The meeting was moved from nine thirty to ten fifteen this morning.
auto_graded_items.explanation: moved from ... to ... 表示改到 10:15。

auto_graded_items.title: 听辨 3
auto_graded_items.prompt: 先点朗读，再判断说话人下一步最可能做什么。
auto_graded_items.speech_text: I have finished the slides, but I still need to check the numbers before sending them.
auto_graded_items.explanation: still need to check 明确指出下一步。

auto_graded_items.title: 听辨 4
auto_graded_items.prompt: 先点朗读，再选择航班延误原因。
auto_graded_items.speech_text: The flight is delayed because heavy fog has reduced visibility near the airport.
auto_graded_items.explanation: because 后直接给出原因 heavy fog。

auto_graded_items.title: 听辨 5
auto_graded_items.prompt: 先点朗读，再判断说话人的态度。
auto_graded_items.speech_text: The plan is ambitious, but with a smaller first step, I think it can work.
auto_graded_items.explanation: 承认 ambitious，同时认为缩小第一步后可行，属于谨慎支持。

auto_graded_items.title: 听辨 6
auto_graded_items.prompt: 先点朗读，再选择学生最后借了几本书。
auto_graded_items.speech_text: I planned to borrow four books, but one was unavailable, so I took the other three.
auto_graded_items.explanation: 四本中一本不可借，最后拿了其余三本。

auto_graded_items.title: 阅读 1
auto_graded_items.prompt: A community garden gives residents a place to grow vegetables, but its larger value may be social. People who once passed without speaking now exchange tools, advice, and news. What is the main idea?
options: The garden also strengthens neighborhood connections
auto_graded_items.answer: The garden also strengthens neighborhood connections
auto_graded_items.explanation: 转折后的 larger value may be social 是主旨。

auto_graded_items.title: 阅读 2
auto_graded_items.prompt: The new bus route is longer than the old one, yet it reaches two hospitals and a college. This makes it more useful to many residents. What does “This” refer to?
auto_graded_items.explanation: This 指前句中覆盖两所医院和一所大学这一事实。

auto_graded_items.title: 阅读 3
auto_graded_items.prompt: Mina keeps her phone in another room while writing. She says the first ten minutes feel uncomfortable, but then she can work for nearly an hour without checking messages. What can be inferred?
options: Removing the phone helps her sustain attention
auto_graded_items.answer: Removing the phone helps her sustain attention
auto_graded_items.explanation: 移开手机后能持续工作近一小时，支持该推断。

auto_graded_items.title: 阅读 4
auto_graded_items.prompt: The museum offers free entry on the first Sunday of each month, but visitors must reserve a time online. Which statement is correct?
options: Free entry requires an online time reservation
auto_graded_items.answer: Free entry requires an online time reservation
auto_graded_items.explanation: 免费日仍需在线预约时间。

auto_graded_items.title: 词汇 1
auto_graded_items.prompt: In “The team adopted a flexible schedule,” adopted is closest in meaning to:
auto_graded_items.explanation: adopt a schedule 表示采用一种安排。

auto_graded_items.title: 词汇 2
auto_graded_items.prompt: Choose the best word: Regular feedback can help students ___ their writing.
auto_graded_items.explanation: improve writing 是符合语义的搭配。

auto_graded_items.title: 词汇 3
auto_graded_items.prompt: The word “brief” in “a brief conversation” is closest to:

auto_graded_items.title: 词汇 4
auto_graded_items.prompt: Choose the best connector: The room was small; ___, it was bright and comfortable.

auto_graded_items.title: 阅读 5
auto_graded_items.prompt: A notice explains how to separate glass, paper, food waste, and batteries before collection day. What is the notice mainly designed to do?
auto_graded_items.explanation: 内容围绕分类方法，目的是提供操作说明。

auto_graded_items.title: 阅读 6
auto_graded_items.prompt: The café reduced disposable cups after offering a small discount to customers who brought their own. Which relationship is described?
options: A policy and its observed result
auto_graded_items.answer: A policy and its observed result
auto_graded_items.explanation: 优惠措施之后一次性杯子减少，是措施与观察结果。

auto_graded_items.title: 词汇 5
auto_graded_items.prompt: Choose the best form: The instructions were clear and easy to ___.

auto_graded_items.title: 词汇 6
auto_graded_items.prompt: Choose the best word: Please ___ enough time for the security check before departure.
auto_graded_items.explanation: allow enough time 表示预留足够时间。
